`final class SnapshotAudioSource`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IAudioSource`](/reference/bridges/iaudiosource/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.snapshot` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [SnapshotAudioSource.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/snapshot/SnapshotAudioSource.java)

An audio source that plays nothing, so that snapshot tests need no sound device.

## Description

[`SnapshotRunner`](/reference/testing/snapshotrunner/) registers an audio bridge that creates them.

## Learn more

- [Keep every run identical](/use/learn/running/testing/#keep-every-run-identical)
